newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold steady in limited activity, silver down.
newsitem.headline: India gold steady in limited activity, silver down.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat opened steady at 4,530 rupees per 10 gramme amid limited activity in early trade.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.64 gramme) opened steady at 53,000 rupees per piece.
** Silver (.999) opened 10 rupees lower at 6,390 rupees per kg on fresh unloading by local stockists amid sluggish demand.
Gold 24 carat opened steady at 4,530 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close amid limited supplies in the early trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
Seasonal buying however remained lower than expected and sentiment was subdued on reports of a weak trend in the world market.
"Gold may move down later in the day," one broker said.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.64 gramme) opened steady at 53,000 rupees per piece amid nominal trading. They were steady on Monday after losing 200 rupees last week.
The premiums for import licences for bullion in India remained steady at 12.90/13.00 percent.

Silver (.999) opened 10 rupees lower at 6,390 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,400 rupees on the back of fresh supplies triggered by unloading by local stockists amid sluggish physical demand. Silver was up by 30 rupees per kg on Monday.
"Sentiment was subdued in the early trade but silver may bounce back looking at the rising world prices," one dealer said.
